description: OpenRouter model + API gotchas for the research engine

entries.bad_pattern: Calling moonshotai/kimi-k2.6 for synthesis with a fixed max_tokens and no reasoning control
entries.good_pattern: Pass reasoning:{enabled:false} + a generous max_tokens (16000) for kimi-k2.6 synthesis
entries.description: kimi-k2.6 emits 5k-8k reasoning_tokens BEFORE any content even with no reasoning param. On a large synthesis prompt the reasoning exhausts max_tokens (8192) before the report JSON is produced -> empty content ('No synthesis response'). Fix 2026-06-16: reasoning:{enabled:false} drops reasoning_tokens to 0 with clean JSON; max_tokens 16000; threaded via config.synthReasoning/synthMaxTokens (llm.js reasoning arg now accepts a string effort OR a full reasoning object). Quality holds with reasoning off (verified: honest picks, trap avoided).
